name: Last Window: Mayonaka no Yakusoku
original_name: ラストウィンドウ 真夜中の約束
source:
It is the sequel to Hotel Dusk: Room 215, starring protagonist Kyle Hyde and being placed one year after the events of its predecessor. The game has visual and audio styles similar to the first game's. In this game, Kyle Hyde finds himself in the Cape West Apartments, Los Angeles, in 1980. The story of this sequel is separate from the first game's, even though it includes some connections with it.

from Wikipedia
translation:
本作是《黄昏旅馆：215号房》的续篇，主人公仍是Kyle Hyde，时间设定在前作事件一年后。游戏的视觉和音效风格与前作相近。1980年，Kyle Hyde来到洛杉矶的Cape West公寓。虽然续作故事相对独立，但仍与前作存在若干联系。
